The HTTP client. Add bounded retry with exponential backoff to src/api/client.py for GET requests only. Requirements: retry at most three times; an edge case where a 429 response must honour the Retry-After header when present; add a test in tests/test_client.py using a stubbed transport that fails twice then succeeds; update docs/api.md with the retry policy. Keep the existing request method signature unchanged so callers in src/api/orders.py need no edits. Backoff should start at 100ms and double each attempt with no jitter. Do not retry POST or DELETE requests. Surface the final exception unchanged after retries are exhausted. Add a module level constant MAX_RETRIES. Run tests/test_client.py after the change.
